digest.component_or_area: git-fetch test suite / dribble stall detection
propositions: Scheduler-delayed Python fixture wake-ups reduce actual throughput below the rate promised, causing shared dribble fake remote to be incorrectly classified as stalled during full-suite load.

The same artificial 2-second stall-detection window applied to both zero-byte positive controls and above-floor negative controls makes dribble tests flaky under scheduler delay, while production intentionally uses a 10-second window.
Cumulative catch-up pacing alone is insufficient to fix flakes; libcurl aborts during uninterrupted scheduling gaps before catch-up can recover bytes owed.

Tests must split zero-byte stall cases (kept at 2-second window for deterministic failure) from one production-window (10-second) dribble integration test with real Git/libcurl transfer that crosses the threshold.
